opening_line: Two of your typographers quitting when you moved the studio to the Mac, sure it would never be good enough, sounds a lot like the AI argument designers are having now. Which side is Uptown on this time?

You started BDX because people who do elite work with their hands kept getting out-marketed by outfits half as sharp with twice the budget. How often does a new client show up right after losing a job that way?
